text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion prepares for her return home 
in a year. Though she tries to act as she 
always does, her expression is somewhat 
strained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur had noticed the incongruity as 
well, and vented her pent-up frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion used her reason to suppress 
her true desire to run even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she asserts that she will follow 
destiny. She prioritizes her mission and 
announces her decision to come to terms 
with her feelings on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Understanding her determination, the 
Trainer decided to watch over Fine Motion 
until she could sort out her feelings.
